sources.title: Details of Common Effluent Treatment Plants pertaining to the Clusters of Textile Industries in Tamil Nadu (2020), tnpcb.gov.in/cept.php
Tamil Nadu monthly progress reports to NMCG under NGT O.A. 673/2018 (June 2026 edition)
sources.publisher: Government of Tamil Nadu, via the National Mission for Clean Ganga

provenance.note: Tiruppur district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope tiruppur-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-tiruppur). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.
